Canada Acknowledges Khalistani Role in 1985 Air India Bombing

Canada has officially acknowledged for the first time that Khalistani extremists were responsible for the 1985 bombing of Air India Flight 182, which killed 329 people. The admission comes 41 years after the attack, which occurred en route from Toronto to Mumbai. This development is seen by some as vindication for India's long-held position on the matter.
